documents.title: Noting In The Board Meeting Dated 29.10.2026 Delay In Submission Of Shareholding Pattern Under Reg 31(1)(B) To NSE.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported strong financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27, highlighting growth across income, EBITDA, and PAT. Management expressed confidence in sustaining a growth rate of more than 30% for FY27 and expects similar performance in subsequent years driven by domestic markets, exports to the US, and new business pipelines in Europe. To support this expansion and mitigate labor constraints, the company is investing in automation, robotics, and AI inspection systems. Furthermore, management noted that raw material price volatility is managed through pre-decided pricing mechanisms to pass on cost burdens. Menon Bearings reported a strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, marked by significant year-on-year increases in revenue, EBITDA, and net profit.

guidance.claim: Management expects more than 30% growth for the financial year FY27.
guidance.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

guidance.claim: The company targets EBITDA margins of about 23% for next year.
guidance.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

guidance.claim: The company expects total potential additional business for the current and next financial year to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: For the Alkop segment, management targets INR100 crores for this year and around INR125 crores for next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: Management maintains a conservative revenue guidance of INR360 crores for the full year.
guidance.quote: So, INR360 crores, I would say is a conservative figure and we will stick to that.

guidance.claim: Management expects exports to potentially reach up to 37% of total revenue by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: European market visits have yielded potential business of over 35 crores that will convert into actual sales in FY28 and FY29.
demand_outlook.quote: Along with that, our recently Europe tour is yielding a significant increase in the business and potential of more than INR 35 crores that will be converted into the actual sale in the year '27-'28 and '28-'29.

demand_outlook.claim: Additional business expected for 2026-27 is around 30 crores on a consolidated basis.
demand_outlook.quote: And what I feel, that considering the current business pipeline and the commercial discussions and RFQs that we have received, for '26-'27, additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on consolidated basis.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects visits to Canada and the USA to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: That is because, more particularly, due to our last month's visit to Canada and USA, is expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans investment in Menon Alkop of around 5 crores and around 4.5 crores in Menon Bearings over the next 12 to 15 months.
capex_expansion.quote: So what figures we have told you, what we are going to achieve. So this is the investment we are doing to increase productivity and to get these numbers. So this is the investment we are getting, and roughly ROI will be in the next 2.5, 3 years, should be the return on investment on this investment what we are doing.

capex_expansion.claim: Brake capacity expansion includes ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning a CapEx of around INR4 crores for the Alkop segment alone this year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: The dynamometer for the brake segment is under construction and expected to be commissioned by the end of August.
capex_expansion.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

margins_costs.claim: Segment-wise margins are 30% to 35% in Brakes, 18% to 19% in Alkop, and 23% in Bearings.
margins_costs.quote: Okay, so far as Brakes is concerned, the margins are 30% to 35%. It depends upon the mix of the product, but it is between 30% to 35%, okay, that is one thing. In Alkop, it is 18% to 19%, whereas in Bearing, it is 23%, okay?

margins_costs.claim: The company has a pre-decided formula to pass on raw material price burdens to customers or reduce prices when input costs fall.
margins_costs.quote: You see, as I already told you that whatever raw material prices, those are volatile, but we are always having a pre-decided formula. So far as increasing the raw material is concerned, we can pass on that burden to the customers or if the prices are reduced, then those prices will get reduced.

margins_costs.claim: Operating expenses were 65.28 Crores in Q2FY27 compared to 41.47 Crores in Q2FY26.
Employee cost was 13.40 Crores in Q2FY27.
EBITDA margin stood at 22.00% for Q2FY27.
PAT margin stood at 14.60% for Q2FY27.
EBITDA margin in the brakes segment reached 25% during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: But at the same time, I would like to tell you that right from 12% EBITDA earlier, now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated margins are expected to be sustained around 20% to 21% over a period of time.
margins_costs.quote: But overall, on a consolidated basis, if you see, we will sustainaround 20% to 21% of margins over a period of time.

margins_costs.claim: Prices of certain consumables like carbide tools have increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

orders_capacity.claim: For 2027-28, estimated additional business is expected to be 131 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: And for '27-'28, we expect that estimated additional business will be of INR 131 crores, so that, the growth rate will be obviously more than 30%, with '28-'29, the growth driver, we are having the list of all customers also from whom we are estimated to get the business, RFQs are there, and discussions are going on, commercials have been finalized.

orders_capacity.claim: For 2029, the company expects additional business of 157 crores excluding potential Europe business.
orders_capacity.quote: And with this, for 2029, we expect additional business of INR 157 crores, excluding potential business of INR 35 crores of Europe that we estimate it will take little more time, but 100% we are going to convert that.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is a single source supplier for John Deere for more than 20 years.
orders_capacity.quote: Like John Deere, we are single source for them for last more than 20 years.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx is being financed through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Whatever CapEx that we are doing, that is out of internal accruals, which are definitely having the impact on the cash accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded entirely through internal accruals without taking fresh loans.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were stuck over the prior three months due to backlogs caused by the Strait of Hormuz and war.
risks_headwinds.quote: But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

management_commitments.claim: Automated visual systems and a lot of automation will be put in place in the next 9 to 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: So some of them are already implemented, some are under development. So in the next 9 to 12 months, a lot of automation and visual systems are getting in place where we save on manpower, we save on time that leads in productivity, and quality is more focused.

management_commitments.claim: A robotic automation roadmap is rolling out five initiatives from November 2026 to April 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Five initiatives rolling out Nov 2026 – Apr 2027 to lift productivity, quality and machine utilization

management_commitments.claim: Installation of the Dual-CNC robotic cell (AMS) for Honeywell STT caps is underway for November 2026.
Design for the Dual-VMC robotic cell (Brother) for JD ISG parts is complete with execution in progress for January 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Design complete; execution in progress Jan 2027

management_commitments.claim: Simulation and design for the Dual-VMC robotic cell (AMS) for Honeywell STT housings are underway for March 2027.
Design exploration with supplier for vision inspection and powder coating automation is slated for April 2027.
In the railway brake segment, the company expects an initial business of INR5 crores to INR6 crores in the first year.
management_commitments.quote: and with this in the first year itself, we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting an EV share of 8% in the Alkop business for the near future over the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: So that is showing us confidence also that we can do these high technical parts. And we are taking efforts for Eaton Concentric also, when a more critical part comes to them, we are a preferred --Alkop is a preferred supplier for them also. So we are also targeting, so 8% is for the near future, for the next two years.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets reaching INR500 crores in revenue by 2030, or potentially sooner within the next 2-3 years as an internal target.
management_commitments.quote: We were supposed to reach INR500 crore in 2030, but we are trying to do it as soon as possible. So, in the next 2-3 years, it's our internal target, but let's see.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
